name: Turin DF64V
details: Electric single-dose grinder with 64 mm flat burrs, variable speed and a stepless dial 0–90. Also sold under other brands.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0–11, espresso 8–27, moka pot 26–55, AeroPress 22–85, V60 30–59, filter coffee machine 20–79, French press 59–90, cold brew 70–90. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. For the stock burrs.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
